name: Creature Model Info
description: Per display id (CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc) model data used by the server: bounding radius and combat reach for distance checks, default walk/run speeds, gender and the alternative model of the other gender, plus an alternative (non-combat/spirit healer) model.

fields.name: Bounding Radius
fields.help: Model collision radius, used for melee/interaction distance calculation.

fields.name: Combat Reach
fields.help: Combat reach of the model, used for melee range calculation (player models always use 1.5).

fields.name: Speed Walk
fields.help: Default walking speed for any creature using this model.

fields.name: Speed Run
fields.help: Default running speed for any creature using this model.

fields.name: Gender
fields.help: Gender of this model: 0 = male, 1 = female, 2 = none/neutral.

fields.name: Model Id Other Gender
fields.help: Display id of the same creature model in the other gender (used when a creature_template offers gendered models). 0 = none.

fields.name: Model Id Alternative
fields.help: Alternative display id, e.g. the model shown to dead players by spirit healers. 0 = none.
